notes.title: Fix for minor technical things
notes.content:
Hello puzzle friends!

With this patch, we are fixing some minor technical issues.

[list]
    [*]Everyone who was affected by a problem with the save game file should be able to start the game normally again
    [*]Adjustments to textures
    [*]A wrong level connection has been corrected
    [*]Credits for the translations have been added
[/list]

All the best and have a great day!
